description: Scope sensor for modernization runs. On an edit it warns when the file is one the run parent owns exclusively, and when a source file exceeds the project's declared line-length limit. It is a sensor: it emits a message, returns no permission decision, and never edits, formats, or creates a file. It deliberately does not run the project lint command - that is a whole-project script, too slow to fire on every edit, and lint remains a stage closing gate.
